name.en: Stanford Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Stanford-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة ستانفورد للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision deadline 5 Jan 2027 (Restrictive Early Action 1 Nov 2026), per Stanford's first-year deadlines page updated Sept 2026. Aid must be requested in the admission application.

summary.en: Stanford meets the full demonstrated financial need of every admitted student, including international citizens who requested aid when they applied. Admission is need-aware for international applicants, and there are no merit scholarships.
summary.ka: Stanford ფარავს ყველა მიღებული სტუდენტის სრულ დადასტურებულ ფინანსურ საჭიროებას, მათ შორის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების, თუ დახმარება განაცხადისას მოითხოვეს. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება და მერიტ სტიპენდიები არ არსებობს.
summary.ar: تغطي ستانفورد كامل الحاجة المالية المثبتة لكل طالب مقبول، بمن فيهم الطلاب الدوليون الذين طلبوا المساعدة عند التقديم. القبول يأخذ الحاجة المالية في الاعتبار للمتقدمين الدوليين، ولا توجد منح على أساس التفوق.

about.en:
Stanford University offers need-based financial aid to a limited number of international (non-US) undergraduates each year. If you request aid in your application and are admitted, Stanford promises to meet your full demonstrated need with institutional scholarship funds, so the family contribution is set by what your family can actually pay.

For international citizens the admission review is need-aware: your aid request is a factor in the decision, so competition is extremely high. Stanford does not award merit scholarships (except a few athletic ones), so need-based aid is the only route to funding.

You must request aid when you apply. Students who do not request aid at admission cannot apply for it later in their four years. Apply Restrictive Early Action by 1 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 5 Jan 2027 via the Common App.

en: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students
Grants, not loans, from Stanford's own scholarship funds
Apply REA (1 Nov) or RD (5 Jan 2027)

eligibility.en: Citizens of any country applying as first-year undergraduates. International citizens (not US citizens, permanent residents or eligible non-citizens) are reviewed need-aware. Aid must be requested in the admission application. English proficiency expected.

en: Submit the Common App to Stanford by 5 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (REA)
Indicate on the application that you are applying for financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and financial documents listed on Stanford's financial aid website
If admitted, receive an aid offer that meets your full calculated need

costs.en: Aid covers the gap between Stanford's full cost of attendance (tuition, housing, food, fees, books, personal costs) and the family contribution. Application fee US$90 (waivers possible).

score_reason: Full-need aid at a top-5 university, but need-aware and highly selective; RD 5 Jan 2027.

name.en: Rice University Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Rice University-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة رايس للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision application deadline 4 Jan 2027; RD financial aid documents due 1 Feb 2027 (ED I aid docs 15 Nov). Dates from Rice's international aid page for the 2027-28 cycle.

summary.en: Rice meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants for international students it admits with aid. Admission is need-aware for international applicants, so you must request aid in your application.
summary.ka: Rice ფარავს დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს გრანტებით იმ საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებსაც დახმარებით იღებს. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება, ამიტომ დახმარება განაცხადშივე უნდა მოითხოვოთ.
summary.ar: تغطي رايس 100% من الحاجة المثبتة بمنح غير مستردة للطلاب الدوليين الذين تقبلهم بمساعدة مالية. القبول يأخذ الحاجة في الاعتبار للدوليين، لذا يجب طلب المساعدة في طلب الالتحاق.

about.en:
Rice University in Houston offers need-based financial aid to international first-year students. International students who are admitted with aid receive 100% of their demonstrated need met with institutional grant aid (they are not part of the domestic Rice Investment programme).

Admission is need-aware for international applicants: your request for aid is considered alongside your application. Rice also automatically considers all admitted students for its limited merit scholarships.

Apply Early Decision I (1 Nov 2026), Early Decision II or Regular Decision (4 Jan 2027) and tick that you want aid. You then submit the CSS Profile (school code 6609), tax documents with English translations and the International Student Financial Statement.

en: 100% of demonstrated need met with grants
Automatic merit scholarship consideration
RD deadline 4 Jan 2027, aid documents 1 Feb

eligibility.en: Non-US citizens applying as first-year students. Must indicate the aid request on the admission application. International transfer applicants receive no aid.

en: Apply via Common App or Coalition by 4 Jan 2027 (RD) and indicate you are applying for aid
Complete the CSS Profile (code 6609)
Upload parent and student tax documents with official English translations in the applicant portal
Submit the International Student Financial Statement
Receive aid decision with your admission decision (RD around 1 April)

costs.en: Grant aid covering demonstrated need up to the full cost of attendance (tuition, fees, housing, food).

score_reason: Full-need grants at a top-20 US university; RD 4 Jan 2027.

name.en: Johns Hopkins Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Johns Hopkins-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة جونز هوبكنز للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: RD and ED II application deadline 2 Jan 2027; financial aid deadline 15 Jan 2027 (ED I: 1 Nov / 15 Nov 2026). From JHU's deadlines page.

summary.en: Johns Hopkins meets 100% of demonstrated need, without loans, for international students it admits. Admission is need-aware for international aid applicants and merit awards are considered automatically.
summary.ka: Johns Hopkins ფარავს დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს, სესხების გარეშე, მიღებული საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის. დახმარების მომთხოვნ საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებზე მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება, მერიტ სტიპენდიები კი ავტომატურად განიხილება.
summary.ar: تغطي جونز هوبكنز 100% من الحاجة المثبتة دون قروض للطلاب الدوليين المقبولين. القبول يراعي الحاجة للمتقدمين الدوليين الذين يطلبون مساعدة، وتُدرَس منح التفوق تلقائيًا.

about.en:
Johns Hopkins University offers need-based financial aid to international first-year applicants. For admitted international citizens, Hopkins meets 100% of demonstrated need with no loans, meaning the aid package is made of grants and work-study.

Admission is need-aware for international students who apply for aid, so your request is considered in the admission decision. A limited number of merit scholarships are awarded automatically. If you do not apply for aid as a first-year, you cannot apply later.

Apply via Common App or Coalition by 2 Jan 2027 (RD/ED II) and submit the CSS Profile or the free JHU International Student Financial Aid Application by 15 Jan 2027. All international applicants also submit a Certification of Finances.

en: 100% of demonstrated need met without loans
Free JHU aid form available instead of the CSS Profile
RD deadline 2 Jan 2027

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-year students. International transfer students are not eligible for aid. Aid must be requested at the time of application.

en: Apply by 2 Jan 2027 (RD) and indicate that you need financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile or JHU International Student Financial Aid Application by 15 Jan 2027
Submit the Certification of Finances from your applicant portal
Receive aid award with admission decision

costs.en: Grant aid covering demonstrated need (tuition, housing, meals, fees, books, travel) with no loans for international citizens.

score_reason: Loan-free full-need aid at a top-10 university; aid forms due 15 Jan 2027.

name.en: Swarthmore College Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Swarthmore College-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في كلية سوارثمور للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision deadline is typically 4 January; the international page refers to its dates page for exact Fall 2027 dates. Aid documents due within 7 days of the admission decision.

summary.en: Swarthmore meets 100% of need for admitted international students with no loans, averaging over US$93,000 a year. Admission is need-aware for international citizens.
summary.ka: Swarthmore ფარავს საჭიროების 100%-ს მიღებული საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის სესხების გარეშე, საშუალოდ წელიწადში 93 000 აშშ დოლარზე მეტით. საერთაშორისო მოქალაქეებზე მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება.
summary.ar: تغطي سوارثمور 100% من حاجة الطلاب الدوليين المقبولين دون قروض، بمتوسط يتجاوز 93 ألف دولار سنويًا. القبول يراعي الحاجة المالية للمواطنين الدوليين.

about.en:
Swarthmore College, one of the top liberal arts colleges in the US, meets 100% of institutionally determined need for admitted international students. Aid can cover full tuition, fees, housing, food, academic supplies and some personal expenses, and packages contain no loans. The average award for the Class of 2030 was over US$93,000.

Admission is need-aware for international citizens, so requesting aid affects your chances. Admitted international students receive a CSS Profile fee waiver.

Apply Early Decision or Regular Decision via the Common App, request aid in the application, and submit financial documents through the applicant portal within seven days of your decision.

en: 100% of need met, no loans
Average international award over US$93,000 a year
CSS Profile fee waiver for international students

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-years. If you might need aid at any point in your four years, you must say so on the admission application. English test, Swarthmore video response or InitialView/Vericant interview required.

en: Apply via Common App (ED I, ED II or RD, typically 4 Jan)
Request financial aid in the application
Submit an English score, Swarthmore Video Response or video interview
Upload financial documents in the portal within 7 days of your admission decision

costs.en: Up to full tuition, fees, housing, food, an US$800 book allowance and some personal expenses.

score_reason: No-loan full-need aid at a top-3 liberal arts college.

name.en: Pomona College Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Pomona College-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في كلية بومونا للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Pomona's RD deadline is usually 8 January; ED I 1 Nov. The international page confirms international students use the same ED I / ED II / RD rounds; confirm exact Fall 2027 date on the apply page.

summary.en: Pomona meets the full need of every admitted international student, without loans, averaging nearly US$74,000 a year. Admission is need-aware for international applicants and aid is need-based only.
summary.ka: Pomona ფარავს ყველა მიღებული საერთაშორისო სტუდენტის სრულ საჭიროებას სესხების გარეშე, საშუალოდ წელიწადში თითქმის 74 000 აშშ დოლარით. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებზე მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება.
summary.ar: تغطي بومونا كامل حاجة كل طالب دولي مقبول دون قروض، بمتوسط يقارب 74 ألف دولار سنويًا. القبول يراعي الحاجة للمتقدمين الدوليين والمساعدة قائمة على الحاجة فقط.

about.en:
Pomona College in southern California, part of the Claremont Colleges consortium, meets the full demonstrated need of every admitted international student. Loans are not used: aid comes as grants and campus work. About 41% of international students receive aid, averaging nearly US$74,000 a year.

There are no merit or athletic scholarships, so need-based aid is the only funding. Admission is need-aware for international applicants.

Apply Early Decision I, Early Decision II or Regular Decision via the Common App or QuestBridge, request aid, and submit the CSS Profile and financial documents.

en: Full need met for every admitted international student
No loans in aid packages
Access to classes across the five Claremont Colleges

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-years who are not currently enrolled full time at another college. Need-aware admission.

en: Apply via Common App (ED I, ED II or RD)
Indicate that you are applying for financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and requested financial documents
Receive your aid offer with your admission decision

costs.en: Grants and campus work covering the full cost of attendance minus family contribution.

score_reason: No-loan full-need aid at a top liberal arts college.

name.en: Charles J. Turck Presidential Honor Scholarship & Need-Based Aid — Macalester College (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Charles J. Turck-ის საპრეზიდენტო საპატიო სტიპენდია და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება — Macalester College (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة تشارلز ج. تيرك الرئاسية الشرفية والمساعدة القائمة على الحاجة — كلية ماكاليستر (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Macalester's international page lists Regular Decision 22 Jan, ED II 8 Jan and ED I/EA 9 Nov for the Fall 2027 cycle (2027-28 aid forms).

summary.en: Macalester automatically considers every international applicant for the Turck Presidential Honor Scholarship of up to US$40,000 a year, and offers need-based aid on top. You must submit the CSS Profile or ISAFA plus a financial declaration to be considered.
summary.ka: Macalester ყველა საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტს ავტომატურად განიხილავს Turck-ის საპრეზიდენტო სტიპენდიისთვის, წელიწადში 40 000 აშშ დოლარამდე, და დამატებით საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას სთავაზობს. განსახილველად საჭიროა CSS Profile ან ISAFA და ფინანსური დეკლარაცია.
summary.ar: تنظر ماكاليستر تلقائيًا في كل متقدم دولي لمنحة تيرك الرئاسية الشرفية حتى 40 ألف دولار سنويًا، وتقدم مساعدة قائمة على الحاجة إضافة إليها. يجب تقديم CSS Profile أو ISAFA وإقرار مالي.

about.en:
Macalester College in Saint Paul, Minnesota, is known for its strong international focus: about one in seven students comes from outside the US. Each year it awards the Charles J. Turck Presidential Honor Scholarship, worth up to US$40,000 a year, to a limited number of international students with strong academic potential. All international applicants are considered automatically.

Macalester also offers need-based aid to international students. Admission is need-aware and competition for aid is keen. Aid packages include on-campus work (about 9 hours a week) and may include institutional loans.

Apply Early Decision I / Early Action by 9 Nov, Early Decision II by 8 Jan or Regular Decision by 22 Jan 2027. Aid applicants must submit the CSS Profile or the free International Student Application for Financial Assistance (ISAFA) and the Macalester Financial Declaration Form, or they will not be considered for admission.

en: Merit award up to US$40,000 a year, automatic consideration
Need-based aid for international students
Free ISAFA form accepted instead of the CSS Profile

eligibility.en: Non-US citizens applying as first-year students. Aid must be requested at admission; students cannot apply for aid after enrolling.

en: Apply via Common App by 22 Jan 2027 (RD) or earlier rounds
For aid: submit the CSS Profile or 2027-28 ISAFA
Submit the Macalester Financial Declaration Form from the applicant portal
Merit scholarship is decided automatically from your application

costs.en: Turck scholarship up to US$40,000 a year toward tuition (~US$70,000+); need-based grants, campus work and loans can cover more.

score_reason: Automatic merit up to $40k plus need aid; RD 22 Jan 2027.

name.en: Clark University Presidential Scholarship (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Clark University-ის საპრეზიდენტო სტიპენდია (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المنحة الرئاسية في جامعة كلارك (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Clark lists Regular Decision and ED II on 15 January (ED I/EA 1 Nov). Scholarship requires applying by the admissions deadline; confirm the Fall 2027 date with admissions.

summary.en: Clark's Presidential Scholarship covers full tuition, on-campus housing and meals for four years for about five students a year, and international applicants are eligible. All admitted students are also automatically considered for Clark merit scholarships.
summary.ka: Clark-ის საპრეზიდენტო სტიპენდია ოთხი წლის განმავლობაში ფარავს სრულ სწავლის საფასურს, კამპუსზე საცხოვრებელსა და კვებას დაახლოებით ხუთი სტუდენტისთვის წელიწადში; საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებსაც შეუძლიათ მიღება. ყველა მიღებული სტუდენტი ავტომატურად განიხილება მერიტ სტიპენდიებისთვის.
summary.ar: تغطي المنحة الرئاسية في كلارك الرسوم الدراسية كاملة والسكن الجامعي والوجبات لأربع سنوات لنحو خمسة طلاب سنويًا، والطلاب الدوليون مؤهلون. كما يُنظر تلقائيًا في جميع المقبولين لمنح كلارك للتفوق.

about.en:
Clark University is a research university in Worcester, Massachusetts. Its Presidential Scholarship is awarded to 3-5 first-year students a year and covers full tuition, on-campus housing and meals for four years; recipients pay roughly US$12,000-15,000 a year for remaining fees and costs.

There is no separate application. The scholarship committee reviews admitted students based on their admission application, and finalists are invited to an interview. All admitted undergraduates, regardless of citizenship, are also automatically considered for Clark's other merit scholarships, and Clark offers need-aware need-based aid to international students.

Apply by 1 Nov 2026 (ED I/EA) or 15 Jan 2027 (ED II/RD). International aid applicants must complete the International Student Certification of Finances and Financial Assistance Application in the applicant portal.

en: Full tuition, housing and meals for four years
Open to students of any citizenship
Automatic consideration for other merit awards

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any citizenship. Selection is merit-based; finalists interview.

en: Apply to Clark via Common App by 15 Jan 2027 (or EA/ED I by 1 Nov)
No separate scholarship application
If shortlisted, complete a finalist interview
For need-based aid, submit the International Student Certification of Finances and Financial Assistance form

costs.en: Full tuition, on-campus housing and meals; students cover remaining fees and personal costs (~US$12,000-15,000/year).

score_reason: Near-full ride open to internationals, very small number of awards.

name.en: UBC International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES) & Outstanding International Student Award (2027)
name.ka: UBC-ის საერთაშორისო მთავარი შესასვლელი სტიპენდია (IMES) და გამორჩეული საერთაშორისო სტუდენტის ჯილდო (2027)
name.ar: منحة القبول الكبرى للطلاب الدوليين (IMES) وجائزة الطالب الدولي المتميز في جامعة كولومبيا البريطانية (2027)

deadline_note: Automatic consideration if you apply to UBC by the 15 Jan 2027 admission deadline (confirmed on UBC Dates and deadlines). Award decisions mid-Feb to end of April.

summary.en: UBC automatically considers international first-years for merit entrance awards worth CA$10,000-25,000, renewable for up to three more years (IMES) or one-time (OIS). Apply to UBC by 15 Jan 2027; no separate form.
summary.ka: UBC საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებს ავტომატურად განიხილავს 10 000-25 000 კანადური დოლარის მერიტ სტიპენდიებისთვის, რომელიც შეიძლება განახლდეს კიდევ სამი წლით (IMES) ან ერთჯერადია (OIS). საკმარისია UBC-ზე 2027 წლის 15 იანვრამდე განაცხადის შეტანა.
summary.ar: تنظر UBC تلقائيًا في طلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين لمنح قبول بقيمة 10,000-25,000 دولار كندي، قابلة للتجديد حتى ثلاث سنوات إضافية (IMES) أو لمرة واحدة (OIS). قدّم إلى UBC قبل 15 يناير 2027 دون نموذج منفصل.

about.en:
The University of British Columbia (Vancouver and Okanagan campuses) gives two merit-based entrance awards to outstanding international students. The International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES) is worth CA$10,000-25,000 a year for 2027/28 and is renewable for up to three further years; the Outstanding International Student (OIS) Award is a one-time award of CA$10,000-25,000.

Both are based on academic achievement, intellectual promise and extracurricular or community involvement, not financial need. You are considered automatically when you apply to UBC by the admission deadline; decisions come between mid-February and the end of April, before the 1 May acceptance date. Students nominated for the separate International Scholars Program cannot receive these awards.

en: CA$10,000-25,000 per year, renewable up to 4 years (IMES)
No separate application
Decisions before the 1 May acceptance deadline

eligibility.en: International students who will study on a Canadian study permit, new to UBC, entering directly from secondary school (OIS also allows post-secondary transfers). Exceptional grades and strong extracurriculars.

en: Apply to UBC by 15 Jan 2027 with your personal profile
Submit grades and documents as requested
No scholarship form needed: successful recipients are notified between mid-February and April

costs.en: Partial: CA$10,000-25,000 a year against international tuition of roughly CA$45,000-60,000.

score_reason: Automatic, renewable merit award at a top-40 university; apply by 15 Jan 2027.

name.en: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship — University of Toronto (2027 entry)
name.ka: Lester B. Pearson-ის საერთაშორისო სტიპენდია — University of Toronto (2027 მიღება)
name.ar: منحة ليستر ب. بيرسون الدولية — جامعة تورنتو (قبول 2027)

deadline_note: Scholarship application and documents due 6 Nov 2026. School nominations (9 Oct 2026) and OUAC application (16 Oct 2026) already closed: only nominated students can still submit. Next cycle opens to schools in July 2027.

summary.en: The Pearson Scholarship covers tuition, books, fees and full residence for four years at U of T for about 37 international students a year. Nominated students must finish the scholarship application by 6 Nov 2026.
summary.ka: Pearson-ის სტიპენდია ოთხი წლის განმავლობაში ფარავს სწავლას, წიგნებს, მოსაკრებლებსა და სრულ საცხოვრებელს U of T-ში, წელიწადში დაახლოებით 37 საერთაშორისო სტუდენტისთვის. ნომინირებულმა სტუდენტებმა განაცხადი 2026 წლის 6 ნოემბრამდე უნდა დაასრულონ.
summary.ar: تغطي منحة بيرسون الرسوم الدراسية والكتب والرسوم الإضافية والسكن الكامل لأربع سنوات في جامعة تورنتو لنحو 37 طالبًا دوليًا سنويًا. على الطلاب المرشحين إكمال طلب المنحة بحلول 6 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious award for international students. It covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years, and about 37 Pearson Scholars are named each year. It recognises exceptional academic achievement, creativity and leadership in school and community.

You must be nominated by your secondary school (one student per school per year). For 2027 entry, school nominations closed on 9 Oct 2026 and the OUAC admission application on 16 Oct 2026; nominated students receive a private link and must submit the scholarship application and documents by 6 Nov 2026. If you are in an earlier school year, ask your counsellor to have the school register for the next cycle (forms go to schools from early July).

en: Full tuition, books, fees and residence for 4 years
About 37 scholars a year
Nomination by your secondary school required

eligibility.en: Non-Canadian students who need a study permit, in their final year of secondary school in 2026/27 (or graduated no earlier than June 2026), starting at U of T in September 2027. Students already in post-secondary study are not eligible.

en: Your school nominates you (closed 9 Oct 2026 for this cycle)
Apply to at least one U of T undergraduate programme via OUAC
Complete the private-link scholarship application and upload documents by 6 Nov 2026
Finalists are notified by U of T

costs.en: Tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years (worth over CA$300,000).

score_reason: Canada's top international full ride, but only nominated students can still finish (6 Nov 2026).

name.en: University of Alberta President's International Distinction Scholarship (2027 entry)
name.ka: University of Alberta-ს პრეზიდენტის საერთაშორისო გამორჩეულობის სტიპენდია (2027 მიღება)
name.ar: منحة الرئيس للتميز الدولي في جامعة ألبرتا (قبول 2027)

deadline_note: Application-based awards share one scholarship application, deadline 10 January (no year printed; applies to the Fall 2027 intake). Admission-based awards are automatic.

summary.en: Up to 25 first-year international students a year receive up to CA$120,000 over four years. Apply through the University of Alberta's single scholarship application by 10 Jan 2027.
summary.ka: წელიწადში 25-მდე საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელი იღებს 120 000 კანადურ დოლარამდე ოთხ წელიწადში. განაცხადი University of Alberta-ს ერთიანი სტიპენდიის ფორმით 2027 წლის 10 იანვრამდე.
summary.ar: يحصل ما يصل إلى 25 طالبًا دوليًا في السنة الأولى سنويًا على ما يصل إلى 120,000 دولار كندي على أربع سنوات. التقديم عبر طلب المنح الموحد لجامعة ألبرتا قبل 10 يناير 2027.

about.en:
The University of Alberta in Edmonton offers several large awards for international first-year students on a study permit. The President's International Distinction Scholarship goes to 25 students a year and is worth up to CA$120,000 paid over four years. With the same application you are also considered for the Chan Pang Kuen Memorial International Distinction Scholarship (up to CA$120,000) and the International Leader Scholarship (up to CA$15,000).

Separately, all admitted international students are automatically assessed for the International Admission Scholarship (up to CA$10,000) and Regional Excellence Scholarship (up to CA$5,000) based on their admission average. First apply to a degree programme, then complete the single scholarship application by 10 January.

en: Up to CA$120,000 over four years
One application covers several international awards
Automatic admission awards up to CA$10,000 as well

eligibility.en: First-year international students who will study on a Canadian student visa. Strong academic record plus leadership.

en: Apply to a University of Alberta undergraduate programme
Complete the single scholarship application (leadership and achievement questions) by 10 Jan 2027
Offers are made from early winter

costs.en: Up to CA$30,000 a year toward international tuition (around CA$30,000-45,000) and costs.

score_reason: Large renewable award open to all nationalities; one application by 10 Jan 2027.

name.en: University of Waterloo International Student Entrance Scholarships (2027 entry)
name.ka: University of Waterloo-ს შესასვლელი სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 მიღება)
name.ar: منح القبول للطلاب الدوليين في جامعة واترلو (قبول 2027)

deadline_note: Waterloo's main admission application deadline for Fall entry is typically early February (OUAC). Entrance award is automatic; Faculty of Science awards need a separate application and the Math Olympiad Scholarship closes 5 Mar 2027.

summary.en: All international fee-paying first-years admitted to most Waterloo degrees get a CA$10,000 entrance scholarship automatically, and Mathematics and Science faculties add awards of up to CA$80,000. Math olympiad medallists can also apply for up to CA$50,000.
summary.ka: Waterloo-ს უმეტეს პროგრამაზე მიღებული ყველა საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელი ავტომატურად იღებს 10 000 კანადური დოლარის სტიპენდიას, მათემატიკისა და მეცნიერების ფაკულტეტები კი 80 000 დოლარამდე ჯილდოებს ამატებენ. ოლიმპიადის მედალოსნებს შეუძლიათ 50 000 დოლარამდე სტიპენდიაზე განაცხადი.
summary.ar: يحصل كل طلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين المقبولين في معظم برامج واترلو على منحة قبول بقيمة 10,000 دولار كندي تلقائيًا، وتضيف كليتا الرياضيات والعلوم جوائز تصل إلى 80,000 دولار. ويمكن لحاملي ميداليات الأولمبياد التقدم لمنحة تصل إلى 50,000 دولار.

about.en:
The University of Waterloo, Canada's leading university for engineering, computer science and mathematics, now gives every international fee-paying student admitted to a full-time first-year degree a CA$10,000 International Student Entrance Scholarship, paid in two instalments. It appears automatically in the applicant portal from mid-April.

It can be combined with faculty awards: Faculty of Mathematics Global Scholarships (up to 10 awards of CA$12,000-40,000, automatic), Faculty of Science International Student Scholarships (up to 15 awards of CA$25,000-80,000, application required) and the Faculty of Mathematics Olympiad Scholarship (up to CA$50,000 for International Olympiad medallists, apply by 5 Mar 2027).

en: CA$10,000 automatic entrance award for international students
Faculty awards up to CA$80,000
Olympiad medallist scholarship up to CA$50,000

eligibility.en: International fee-paying students admitted to a full-time first-year degree (excludes Medical Sciences, Social Work, Optometry, Pharmacy, transfer and deferred students). Faculty awards have their own criteria.

en: Apply to Waterloo through OUAC (international applicants: by the early-February deadline)
Complete the Admission Information Form
For Science awards, submit the Faculty of Science scholarship application
Olympiad medallists apply for the Math Olympiad Scholarship by 5 Mar 2027

costs.en: CA$10,000 in year one (two CA$5,000 instalments) plus any faculty award; international tuition is roughly CA$65,000+ a year.

score_reason: Automatic award for all internationals plus big faculty awards, but covers a small share of high tuition.

name.en: Carleton University President's Welcome Award for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Carleton University-ის პრეზიდენტის მისასალმებელი ჯილდო საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: جائزة الترحيب الرئاسية للطلاب الدوليين في جامعة كارلتون (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Automatic for September 2027 applicants; Prestige Scholarships need an application by 1 March; grades for the renewable Entrance Scholarship must arrive by 15 June 2027.

summary.en: Every international student entering Carleton from high school receives CA$2,000-5,000 automatically, on top of the renewable Entrance Scholarship for averages of 85%+. Top students (90%+) can also apply for Prestige Scholarships by 1 March.
summary.ka: ყველა საერთაშორისო სტუდენტი, რომელიც Carleton-ში სკოლიდან შედის, ავტომატურად იღებს 2 000-5 000 კანადურ დოლარს, 85%+ საშუალოსთვის განახლებადი შესასვლელი სტიპენდიის გარდა. საუკეთესოებს (90%+) შეუძლიათ Prestige სტიპენდიაზე 1 მარტამდე განაცხადი.
summary.ar: يحصل كل طالب دولي يلتحق بكارلتون من المدرسة الثانوية على 2,000-5,000 دولار كندي تلقائيًا، إضافة إلى منحة القبول المتجددة لمعدلات 85% فأكثر. ويمكن للمتفوقين (90%+) التقدم لمنح Prestige قبل 1 مارس.

about.en:
Carleton University in Ottawa, Canada's capital, automatically gives the President's Welcome Award (CA$2,000-5,000, unlimited number) to international students entering directly from high school who pay international fees; the amount depends on admission grades. It is added to Carleton's renewable Entrance Scholarship, which goes automatically to students with an admission average of 85% or higher.

Students with 90%+ can additionally apply for Prestige Scholarships (application and reference letter by 1 March). Carleton is strong in public affairs, journalism, international relations, engineering and computer science.

en: CA$2,000-5,000 automatic welcome award
Renewable entrance scholarship for 85%+ averages
Prestige Scholarships for 90%+ by application

eligibility.en: International fee-paying students entering directly from high school in September 2027.

en: Apply to Carleton through OUAC
Have all grades sent by 15 June 2027 for entrance-scholarship assessment
Optional: submit Prestige Scholarship application and reference by 1 March 2027

costs.en: Partial: CA$2,000-5,000 welcome award plus renewable entrance scholarship, against tuition of roughly CA$35,000-45,000.

score_reason: Automatic and reachable, but modest amounts.

name.en: Cornell University Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Cornell University-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة كورنيل للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision 2 Jan 2027 (Early Decision 1 Nov 2026); file the 2027-28 CSS Profile as soon as possible after 1 Oct 2026. Dates from Cornell's international aid page.

summary.en: Cornell meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international undergraduates with grants, work-study and, for some incomes, modest loans. Admission is need-aware for international students.
summary.ka: Cornell ფარავს მიღებული საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრების დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს გრანტებით, სამუშაო-სწავლით და ზოგიერთი შემოსავლისთვის მცირე სესხით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებზე მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება.
summary.ar: تغطي كورنيل 100% من الحاجة المثبتة للطلاب الدوليين المقبولين عبر منح وعمل طلابي وقروض معتدلة لبعض الدخول. القبول يراعي الحاجة المالية للطلاب الدوليين.

about.en:
Cornell University, the Ivy League university in Ithaca, New York, meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for every admitted international undergraduate who applied for aid. Packages combine Cornell grants, an annual work-study award and, depending on family income, reasonable student loans.

Admission is need-aware for international applicants, so your aid request is one factor in the decision. Apply Early Decision by 1 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 2 Jan 2027 and complete the CSS Profile (code 2098); Cornell may request extra documents via IDOC. International students generally do not get CSS fee waivers, and Cornell withholds 14% US tax on grant aid above tuition unless a tax treaty applies.

en: 100% of demonstrated need met
Ivy League education across 7 undergraduate colleges
RD deadline 2 Jan 2027

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-years (or transfers) who request aid in the application. Need-aware admission.

en: Apply via Common App by 2 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (ED)
Indicate you are applying for financial aid
Complete the 2027-28 CSS Profile (code 2098)
Upload IDOC documents if requested

costs.en: Grants plus work-study and possible loans covering the full cost of attendance minus family contribution.

score_reason: Full-need aid at an Ivy; RD 2 Jan 2027.

name.en: University of Notre Dame Need-Blind Admission & Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: University of Notre Dame-ის საჭიროებისგან დამოუკიდებელი მიღება და დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: قبول دون اعتبار للحاجة ومساعدة مالية في جامعة نوتردام للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision application 1 Jan 2027, CSS Profile 15 Jan 2027 (REA: 1 Nov / 15 Nov 2026). From Notre Dame's international aid page.

summary.en: Notre Dame admits international undergraduates need-blind and offers need-based University scholarships and student employment. File the CSS Profile by 15 Jan 2027 for Regular Decision.
summary.ka: Notre Dame საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს ფინანსური საჭიროების გაუთვალისწინებლად იღებს და სთავაზობს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ საუნივერსიტეტო სტიპენდიებსა და სტუდენტურ დასაქმებას. Regular Decision-ისთვის CSS Profile 2027 წლის 15 იანვრამდე.
summary.ar: تقبل نوتردام طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين دون اعتبار لقدرتهم على الدفع وتقدم منحًا جامعية قائمة على الحاجة وعملًا طلابيًا. قدّم CSS Profile قبل 15 يناير 2027 للقرار العادي.

about.en:
The University of Notre Dame in Indiana is one of the few US universities whose international undergraduate admission is need-blind: applicants are evaluated without regard to their ability to pay. Admitted students who apply for aid receive need-based packages made of University scholarships and student employment.

Apply Restrictive Early Action by 1 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 1 Jan 2027, then submit the 2027-28 CSS Profile (code 1841) by 15 Nov 2026 or 15 Jan 2027, plus tax or earnings documents through IDOC.

en: Need-blind admission for international students
Need-based University scholarships
CSS Profile due 15 Jan 2027 (RD)

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-year undergraduates.

en: Apply via Common App by 1 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (REA)
Submit the CSS Profile (code 1841) by 15 Jan 2027
Upload parent tax returns or non-filer statement and earnings statements via IDOC

costs.en: Need-based University scholarships and student employment toward tuition, room and board (cost of attendance about US$90,000/year).

score_reason: Rare need-blind admission for internationals; RD 1 Jan 2027.

name.en: Brown University Need-Blind Aid for International First-Years (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Brown University-ის საჭიროებისგან დამოუკიდებელი დახმარება საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: مساعدة مالية دون اعتبار للحاجة في جامعة براون لطلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Brown's aid page lists Early Decision 2 Nov 2026 and RD aid documents by 1 Feb 2027; Brown's RD application deadline is typically 5 January. CSS Profile opens 1 Oct 2026.

summary.en: Brown is need-blind for first-year international applicants and meets full demonstrated need for admitted students. Submit the CSS Profile (no fee waivers) with your Early Decision or Regular Decision application.
summary.ka: Brown საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელ აპლიკანტებს საჭიროების გაუთვალისწინებლად იღებს და მიღებულების სრულ დადასტურებულ საჭიროებას ფარავს. CSS Profile ადრეული ან რეგულარული განაცხადის გვერდით წარადგინეთ.
summary.ar: براون لا تأخذ الحاجة المالية في الاعتبار عند قبول المتقدمين الدوليين للسنة الأولى، وتغطي كامل الحاجة المثبتة للمقبولين. قدّم CSS Profile مع طلبك في القرار المبكر أو العادي.

about.en:
Brown University, the Ivy League university in Providence, became need-blind for first-year international applicants from the class entering in 2025: your request for aid does not affect the admission decision. Brown meets the full demonstrated need of admitted students with grant-based aid.

Apply Early Decision (2 Nov 2026) or Regular Decision (early January 2027) and complete the CSS Profile (code 3189) by the aid deadline (RD: 1 Feb 2027). Brown does not accept the ISFAA and does not give CSS fee waivers; applicants from Iran or North Korea should email the aid office for an alternative.

en: Need-blind for international first-years
Full demonstrated need met
Open Curriculum with no core requirements

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-year students.

en: Apply via Common App (ED 1 Nov / RD early January 2027)
Complete the CSS Profile (code 3189) by 2 Nov 2026 (ED) or 1 Feb 2027 (RD)
Upload IDOC documents only if requested by the College Board

costs.en: Grant aid meeting full need toward a cost of attendance of roughly US$95,000 a year.

score_reason: Need-blind full-need Ivy for internationals.

name.en: Columbia University Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Columbia University-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة كولومبيا للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Columbia's RD deadline is 1 January (ED 1 November); confirm on Columbia Undergraduate Admissions. Aid must be requested in the admission application.

summary.en: Columbia College and Columbia Engineering meet 100% of demonstrated need for international first-years admitted with aid. Admission is need-aware for international applicants.
summary.ka: Columbia College და Columbia Engineering ფარავს დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს დახმარებით მიღებული საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებისთვის. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებზე მიღება საჭიროების გათვალისწინებით ხდება.
summary.ar: تغطي كلية كولومبيا وكلية الهندسة 100% من الحاجة المثبتة لطلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين المقبولين بمساعدة. القبول يراعي الحاجة للمتقدمين الدوليين.

about.en:
Columbia University in New York City meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for international students admitted as first-years (or transfers) pursuing their first degree at Columbia College or Columbia Engineering. Families with lower incomes often pay nothing toward the cost of attendance.

International applicants are reviewed need-aware, and you must say on your admission application that you are seeking aid; otherwise you generally cannot apply later. Apply Early Decision (1 Nov) or Regular Decision (1 Jan 2027) and submit the CSS Profile and documents listed in your applicant portal.

en: 100% of demonstrated need met
Core Curriculum in the heart of New York City
Apply by 1 Jan 2027 (RD)

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-years or transfers for a first bachelor's degree. Must request aid in the admission application.

en: Apply via Common App or QuestBridge by 1 Jan 2027
Indicate that you are seeking financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and financial documents by the aid deadline
Receive aid package with admission decision

costs.en: Grant-based aid covering demonstrated need up to the full cost of attendance.

score_reason: Full-need Ivy in NYC; need-aware for internationals.

name.en: Caltech Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Caltech-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة المالية القائمة على الحاجة في معهد كالتك للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Caltech RD application deadline is typically 3 January (REA 1 Nov). Aid priority deadlines for 2027-28 new applicants: REA 15 Dec 2026, RD 16 Mar 2027 (Caltech financial aid deadlines page).

summary.en: Caltech offers need-based aid to international first-years who request it when applying, under the same policies as for US students. Aid is not available to international transfer or 3/2 applicants.
summary.ka: Caltech საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას სთავაზობს, თუ განაცხადისას მოითხოვენ, იმავე წესებით, როგორც აშშ-ის სტუდენტებს. საერთაშორისო გადმოსვლით აპლიკანტებს დახმარება არ ეკუთვნით.
summary.ar: يقدّم كالتك مساعدة قائمة على الحاجة لطلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين الذين يطلبونها عند التقديم، وفق السياسات ذاتها المطبقة على الطلاب الأمريكيين. لا تتاح المساعدة للمحوّلين الدوليين.

about.en:
Caltech, the small science and engineering institute in Pasadena, offers need-based financial aid to international students who apply as incoming first-years. Its aid policies for international students are mostly the same as for US students; aid is grant-based institutional funding, since internationals cannot receive US federal aid.

You must indicate on your admission application that you plan to apply for aid; students who do not receive aid in their first year cannot apply later. Apply Restrictive Early Action (1 Nov) or Regular Decision (early January 2027) and follow the international financial aid requirements; priority aid deadlines are 15 Dec 2026 (REA) and 16 Mar 2027 (RD).

en: Need-based institutional aid for international first-years
World-leading STEM institute with ~1,000 undergraduates
Aid priority deadline 16 Mar 2027 (RD)

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-years. Not available to transfer or 3/2 applicants. Need-aware admission.

en: Apply via Common App by early January 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov (REA)
Indicate on the application that you will apply for aid
Submit the CSS Profile and international aid documents by the priority deadline
Receive aid offer with or after the admission decision

costs.en: Institutional grants toward tuition, housing, food and fees based on demonstrated need.

score_reason: Need-based aid at a top STEM institute; extremely selective.

name.en: University of Chicago Need-Based Aid & Merit Scholarships for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: University of Chicago-ს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება და მერიტ სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدة القائمة على الحاجة ومنح التفوق في جامعة شيكاغو للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: UChicago's RD/ED II deadline is typically early January (EA/ED I 1 Nov). Aid is available only if requested during the admission process.

summary.en: UChicago gives need-based aid to international students who apply for it during admission, using its own Student Financial Aid Worksheet instead of the CSS Profile. All first-year applicants are also automatically considered for merit scholarships.
summary.ka: UChicago საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას აძლევს საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს, რომლებიც მას მიღებისას ითხოვენ, CSS Profile-ის ნაცვლად საკუთარი ფორმით. ყველა პირველკურსელი აპლიკანტი ავტომატურად განიხილება მერიტ სტიპენდიებისთვისაც.
summary.ar: تقدم جامعة شيكاغو مساعدة قائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين الذين يطلبونها أثناء القبول، باستخدام استمارتها الخاصة بدل CSS Profile. كما يُنظر تلقائيًا في جميع المتقدمين للسنة الأولى لمنح التفوق.

about.en:
The University of Chicago offers need-based financial aid to international first-years who apply for it during the admission process, and automatically considers all first-year applicants (including internationals) for merit scholarships.

International applicants do not file the CSS Profile or FAFSA; instead they submit UChicago's Student Financial Aid Worksheet, an asset verification form and income documents (tax forms or a home-country equivalent translated into English and converted to US dollars, or employer statements/bank records where no tax filing exists). Apply in Early Action, Early Decision I/II or Regular Decision rounds via Common App or Coalition.

en: Need-based aid plus automatic merit consideration
Own free aid worksheet instead of the CSS Profile
Several rounds: EA, ED I, ED II, RD

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-years. Aid only if requested during admission.

en: Apply via Common App or Coalition (EA/ED I 1 Nov; ED II/RD early January 2027)
Indicate you are applying for aid
Submit the Student Financial Aid Worksheet, asset verification form and income documents
Merit scholarships are considered automatically

costs.en: Need-based grants toward the full cost of attendance; merit scholarships vary.

score_reason: Need aid plus merit at a top-10 university.

name.en: AUC Excellence Scholarship Program for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: AUC-ის საუკეთესოობის სტიპენდიის პროგრამა საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: برنامج منح التميز في الجامعة الأمريكية بالقاهرة للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Early admission deadline 1 Feb 2027 (priority for higher awards); regular admission 1 Jun 2027. From AUC's Excellence Scholarship page.

summary.en: AUC's Excellence Scholarship combines categories (academic achievement, international diversity, talents, leadership, liberal arts majors) to cover 20% to 100% of tuition. International applicants are automatically considered for the International Diversity award of up to 30%.
summary.ka: AUC-ის საუკეთესოობის სტიპენდია აერთიანებს კატეგორიებს (აკადემიური მიღწევა, საერთაშორისო მრავალფეროვნება, ნიჭი, ლიდერობა, ლიბერალური ხელოვნების სპეციალობები) და ფარავს სწავლის 20%-დან 100%-მდე. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები ავტომატურად განიხილებიან 30%-მდე მრავალფეროვნების ჯილდოსთვის.
summary.ar: تجمع منحة التميز في الجامعة الأمريكية بالقاهرة فئات عدة (التفوق الأكاديمي، التنوع الدولي، المواهب، القيادة، تخصصات الآداب الحرة) لتغطي من 20% إلى 100% من الرسوم الدراسية. يُنظر تلقائيًا في المتقدمين الدوليين لجائزة التنوع الدولي حتى 30%.

about.en:
The American University in Cairo is an English-language, US-accredited liberal arts university in New Cairo, Egypt. Its Excellence Scholarship Program lets new undergraduates stack several merit categories for a total of 20% to 100% of tuition: Academic Achievement (from 20%, up to 100% for top scorers, automatic), International Diversity (up to 30% for students applying as internationals, automatic), Talents, Leadership and Community Service, and Liberal Arts Majors (each up to 30%, with videos and supporting documents).

Certificate scores are the main criterion (SAT/ACT for American-diploma holders), and financial need is also considered. Apply for admission by 1 Feb 2027 for priority on higher awards, or by 1 Jun 2027 at the latest, submitting the admission, scholarship and financial need assessment applications.

en: 20%-100% of tuition by combining categories
Automatic International Diversity award up to 30%
Priority deadline 1 Feb 2027

eligibility.en: New undergraduate applicants of any nationality for Fall 2027; International Diversity category for students applying as international students. Cut-off scores vary by cohort.

en: Apply for undergraduate admission through the AUC portal by 1 Feb 2027 (early) or 1 Jun 2027
Complete the scholarship application and financial need assessment
For Talents/Leadership/Liberal Arts categories, upload videos and supporting documents
Receive scholarship decision with or after admission

costs.en: 20%-100% tuition waiver; housing and living costs not included unless otherwise stated.

score_reason: Stackable merit up to 100% at a top Arab-region university; open to internationals.

name.en: Georgetown University in Qatar Need-Blind Admission & Need-Based Grants (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Georgetown University in Qatar-ის საჭიროებისგან დამოუკიდებელი მიღება და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული გრანტები (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: قبول دون اعتبار للحاجة ومنح قائمة على الحاجة في جامعة جورجتاون في قطر (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision and CSS Profile both due 15 Jan 2027 (Early Action closed 1 Nov 2026). From GU-Q admissions page.

summary.en: GU-Q admits students of all nationalities need-blind to its Georgetown BSFS degree in Doha, and offers need-based grants through Qatar Foundation. Submit the CSS Profile by 15 Jan 2027.
summary.ka: GU-Q ყველა ეროვნების სტუდენტს საჭიროების გაუთვალისწინებლად იღებს Georgetown-ის BSFS ხარისხზე დოჰაში და Qatar Foundation-ის მეშვეობით საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ გრანტებს სთავაზობს. CSS Profile 2027 წლის 15 იანვრამდე.
summary.ar: تقبل جامعة جورجتاون في قطر الطلاب من جميع الجنسيات دون اعتبار لقدرتهم على الدفع لدرجة BSFS في الدوحة، وتقدم منحًا قائمة على الحاجة عبر مؤسسة قطر. قدّم CSS Profile قبل 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Georgetown University in Qatar, in Doha's Education City, offers the same Bachelor of Science in Foreign Service (international politics, international economics, international history, culture and politics) as Georgetown's Washington campus. Admission is need-blind: ability to pay is not a factor.

Need-based grants are available to students of any nationality; most students combine grants, scholarships and self-funding. Apply Regular Decision through the GU-Q application by 15 Jan 2027 and complete the CSS Profile by the same date so your aid package is ready for August 2027. Tuition was US$71,136 in 2025-26.

en: Need-blind admission for all nationalities
Georgetown School of Foreign Service degree in Doha
Need-based grants via Qatar Foundation

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. Need-based grants require the CSS Profile.

en: Submit the GU-Q application by 15 Jan 2027
Complete the CSS Profile by 15 Jan 2027
Submit any additional Qatar Foundation financial aid documents requested
Decisions released 1 April 2027

costs.en: Need-based grants toward tuition (US$71,136 in 2025-26), housing, books and fees.

score_reason: Need-blind Georgetown degree with need-based grants; RD 15 Jan 2027.

name.en: Khalifa University Undergraduate Scholarship for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Khalifa University-ის საბაკალავრო სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة البكالوريوس في جامعة خليفة للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Fall 2027 undergraduate applications are not yet open (Fall 2026 closed). Khalifa usually opens its undergraduate portal in the winter with deadlines in spring; scholarship is assessed during admission. Check ugapply.ku.ac.ae.

summary.en: Khalifa University awards international undergraduates tiered scholarships from full tuition plus textbooks down to textbooks only, assessed automatically during admission. It is the UAE's leading science and engineering university.
summary.ka: Khalifa University საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს ანიჭებს საფეხურიან სტიპენდიებს, სრული სწავლის საფასურიდან და სახელმძღვანელოებიდან მხოლოდ სახელმძღვანელოებამდე, მიღების პროცესში ავტომატური შეფასებით. ეს არის არაბთა საამიროების წამყვანი საინჟინრო-სამეცნიერო უნივერსიტეტი.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة خليفة الطلاب الدوليين في البكالوريوس منحًا متدرجة من الرسوم الدراسية الكاملة مع الكتب إلى الكتب فقط، وتُقيَّم تلقائيًا أثناء القبول. وهي الجامعة الرائدة في العلوم والهندسة في الإمارات.

about.en:
Khalifa University in Abu Dhabi is the UAE's top-ranked research university for engineering, computing and science. International (non-UAE) undergraduates are considered for a tiered scholarship: Tier I full tuition and textbooks, Tier II 75% tuition, Tier III 50%, Tier IV 25% (all with textbooks) and Tier V textbooks only.

There is no separate scholarship application: eligibility is assessed during admission and places are limited, so meeting minimum criteria does not guarantee an award. Fall 2027 applications open on the Khalifa University applicant portal; check the undergraduate admissions requirements (school grades, English test and maths/physics or SAT requirements) before applying.

en: Up to full tuition plus textbooks
Assessed automatically at admission
Top UAE engineering and science university

eligibility.en: International (non-UAE) applicants admitted to full-time bachelor's programmes. Selection by academic merit; places limited.

en: Check undergraduate admission requirements on ku.ac.ae
Apply on ugapply.ku.ac.ae when the Fall 2027 cycle opens
Submit transcripts, English test and required test scores
Scholarship tier is communicated with admission

costs.en: Tier I: 100% tuition + textbooks; Tier II: 75%; Tier III: 50%; Tier IV: 25%; Tier V: textbooks only. Housing and living costs are separate.

score_reason: Up to full tuition at a strong STEM university, but the 2027 window is not yet published.

name.en: Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar Merit Scholarships & Need-Based Grants (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar-ის მერიტ სტიპენდიები და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული გრანტები (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح التفوق والمنح القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة كارنيجي ميلون في قطر (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Regular Decision priority deadline for the Qatar Foundation need-based grant application is 1 February; international applicants outside Qatar are not eligible for aid in Early Decision. Confirm cycle year with CMU-Q.

summary.en: CMU-Q offers Qatar Foundation need-based grants up to the full cost of attendance to all nationalities, plus a limited number of academic merit scholarships. File the QF grant application by 1 Feb 2027 to be considered for both.
summary.ka: CMU-Q ყველა ეროვნების სტუდენტს სთავაზობს Qatar Foundation-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ გრანტებს სწავლის სრულ ღირებულებამდე, ასევე შეზღუდული რაოდენობის აკადემიურ მერიტ სტიპენდიებს. ორივესთვის განსახილველად QF-ის განაცხადი 2027 წლის 1 თებერვლამდე.
summary.ar: تقدم CMU-Q منح مؤسسة قطر القائمة على الحاجة حتى كامل تكلفة الدراسة لجميع الجنسيات، إضافة إلى عدد محدود من منح التفوق الأكاديمي. قدّم طلب منحة المؤسسة قبل 1 فبراير 2027 للنظر في الاثنتين.

about.en:
Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar offers Carnegie Mellon bachelor's degrees in biological sciences, business administration, computational biology, computer science and information systems in Doha's Education City. Qatar Foundation need-based grants are open to all nationalities, do not need to be repaid and can cover up to the full cost of attendance (about US$86,800 for on-campus students in 2026-27).

CMU-Q also awards a limited number of academic merit scholarships funded with Qatar Foundation; you are considered when you submit the QF grant application, and merit can be combined with need-based grants. International applicants living outside Qatar should apply Regular Decision (aid not available in ED for them) and submit the grant application through the QF portal by 1 February.

en: Need-based grants up to full cost, all nationalities
Limited merit scholarships combined with grants
Carnegie Mellon degree in Doha

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. International applicants outside Qatar must apply Regular Decision to receive aid.

en: Apply to CMU-Q Regular Decision via Common App
Submit the Qatar Foundation need-based grant application on fas.qf.org.qa by 1 Feb 2027
US citizens also file the FAFSA
Merit scholarships are considered from the same application

costs.en: Grants up to full cost of attendance (tuition US$69,702 in 2026-27); merit scholarship amounts vary.

score_reason: CMU degree with QF grants up to full cost; aid form by 1 Feb.

name.en: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at African Leadership University (2027 intakes)
name.ka: Mastercard Foundation-ის სტიპენდიანტთა პროგრამა African Leadership University-ში (2027 მიღებები)
name.ar: برنامج علماء مؤسسة ماستركارد في جامعة القيادة الأفريقية (دفعات 2027)

deadline_note: ALU's January 2027 intake closes 30 Nov 2026 (homepage); September 2027 intake expected to open afterwards. Scholarship deadlines follow ALU admissions; confirm in the application guide.

summary.en: ALU's Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program gives full scholarships to promising young Africans facing financial hardship, especially young women, refugees and young people with disabilities. Apply for ALU's January 2027 intake by 30 Nov 2026.
summary.ka: ALU-ის Mastercard Foundation-ის პროგრამა სრულ სტიპენდიებს აძლევს ფინანსურ სირთულეებში მყოფ ნიჭიერ აფრიკელ ახალგაზრდებს, განსაკუთრებით ქალებს, ლტოლვილებსა და შეზღუდული შესაძლებლობის მქონე ახალგაზრდებს. ALU-ის 2027 წლის იანვრის მიღებაზე განაცხადი 30 ნოემბრამდე.
summary.ar: يمنح برنامج مؤسسة ماستركارد في جامعة القيادة الأفريقية منحًا كاملة للشباب الأفارقة الواعدين الذين يواجهون صعوبات مالية، خاصة الشابات واللاجئين وذوي الإعاقة. قدّم لدفعة يناير 2027 قبل 30 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
African Leadership University (ALU) in Kigali, Rwanda, runs mission-driven bachelor's degrees: BSc (Hons) Software Engineering, Entrepreneurial Leadership, and International Business & Trade. Through its partnership with the Mastercard Foundation it offers full scholarships to promising young leaders from across Africa who face financial adversity, with emphasis on young women, refugees and young people with disabilities.

Apply through ALU's online application (the January 2027 intake closes 30 Nov 2026; the September 2027 intake follows) and indicate that you need financial support. Follow ALU's Admissions Application Guide, which explains the scholarship steps.

en: Full scholarship for African students with financial need
Degrees in software engineering, entrepreneurship, international business
January and September intakes

eligibility.en: Young Africans (citizens of African countries) facing economic hardship, with leadership potential and a commitment to giving back. Priority for young women, refugees, displaced youth and people with disabilities.

en: Read ALU's Admissions Application Guide
Submit the ALU application by 30 Nov 2026 (January 2027 intake) or the later September 2027 deadline
Indicate financial need and complete scholarship questions
Take part in any assessments or interviews

costs.en: Full scholarship (tuition and support costs as defined by the Mastercard Foundation programme).

score_reason: Full scholarship for African students; Jan 2027 intake closes 30 Nov 2026.

name.en: University of Rochester Merit Scholarships & Need-Based Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: University of Rochester-ის მერიტ სტიპენდიები და საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح التفوق والمساعدة القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة روتشستر للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Priority scholarship deadline 1 Dec 2026 (all materials in for highest merit consideration); ED II and RD applications 5 Jan 2027. From Rochester's Dates & Deadlines page.

summary.en: Every admitted applicant to Rochester, regardless of citizenship, is considered for merit scholarships: about 75% of admitted students received one for 2026-27, averaging around US$20,000 a year. Send everything by the 1 Dec 2026 priority scholarship deadline for the best chance.
summary.ka: Rochester-ზე ყველა მიღებული აპლიკანტი, მოქალაქეობის მიუხედავად, მერიტ სტიპენდიისთვის განიხილება: 2026-27 წელს მიღებულთა დაახლოებით 75%-მა მიიღო იგი, საშუალოდ წელიწადში 20 000 დოლარი. საუკეთესო შანსისთვის ყველაფერი 2026 წლის 1 დეკემბრამდე გააგზავნეთ.
summary.ar: يُنظر في كل متقدم مقبول في روتشستر، بغض النظر عن جنسيته، لمنح التفوق: حصل نحو 75% من المقبولين عليها في 2026-27 بمتوسط 20 ألف دولار سنويًا. أرسل كل الوثائق قبل الموعد الأولوي للمنح في 1 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
The University of Rochester in upstate New York is a research university known for optics, music (Eastman School), engineering and its open curriculum. All admitted undergraduate applicants, including international students, are considered for merit scholarships with no extra documents; around 75% of admitted students for 2026-27 received one, averaging about US$20,000 a year, and named high-school awards range from US$10,000 to 35,000 a year.

Need-based aid is also available to a small number of international students (need-aware; CSS Profile code 2928, limited fee waivers until 15 Jan). To maximise merit consideration, submit your application and materials by the 1 Dec 2026 priority scholarship deadline; otherwise ED II and RD close on 5 Jan 2027.

en: ~75% of admitted students receive merit aid
Average award about US$20,000 a year
Priority scholarship deadline 1 Dec 2026

summary.ka: PolyU საერთაშორისო კვალიფიკაციის მქონე არაადგილობრივ სტუდენტებს ავტომატურად განიხილავს განახლებადი კულტურის ელჩის სტიპენდიისთვის, წელიწადში 60 000 ჰონკონგურ დოლარამდე. განაცხადი 2026 წლის 17 ნოემბრამდე ან მოგვიანებით მთავარ რაუნდში.

about.en:
The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, strong in engineering, design, hotel and tourism management, business and health sciences, offers the Cultural Ambassador Scholarship for Non-Local Students: renewable, up to HK$60,000 a year, for non-local students with international qualifications. No application is required; eligible students are considered automatically. PolyU lists 26 scholarships in total, and students may hold several up to annual tuition plus HK$60,000.

Apply through PolyU's international/other qualifications route; Sept 2027 programmes show an early-round deadline of 17 Nov 2026, with main and extended rounds after that.

en: Up to HK$60,000 a year, renewable
Automatic consideration
Combinable with other PolyU awards

eligibility.en: Non-local students holding international qualifications admitted to PolyU undergraduate programmes.

en: Choose your Sept 2027 programme and apply online via the international qualifications route
Submit by 17 Nov 2026 (early round) or later main round
Scholarship decided automatically with admission

costs.en: Up to HK$60,000 a year against non-local tuition of roughly HK$190,000-200,000.

score_reason: Automatic partial award; early round 17 Nov 2026.

name.ar: منح جامعة كوريا لطلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين — أنام العالمية، القائد العالمي، أصدقاء KU العالميين (2027)

deadline_note: Spring 2027 international admission has closed; the Fall 2027 round usually runs in early spring 2027. Scholarships are decided in admission evaluation; confirm dates with admission@korea.ac.kr.

summary.en: Korea University automatically considers international freshmen for scholarships of up to 100% tuition, including the Anam Global Scholarship (full tuition for 8 semesters) and KU Global Friends for applicants from Africa, South America and developing countries.
summary.ka: Korea University საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებს ავტომატურად განიხილავს 100%-მდე სწავლის სტიპენდიებისთვის, მათ შორის Anam Global (სრული სწავლა 8 სემესტრით) და KU Global Friends აფრიკის, სამხრეთ ამერიკისა და განვითარებადი ქვეყნების აპლიკანტებისთვის.
summary.ar: تنظر جامعة كوريا تلقائيًا في طلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين لمنح تصل إلى 100% من الرسوم، منها منحة أنام العالمية (رسوم كاملة لثمانية فصول) ومنحة أصدقاء KU للمتقدمين من أفريقيا وأمريكا الجنوبية والدول النامية.

about.en:
Korea University, one of Korea's top three 'SKY' universities, awards several scholarships to newly admitted international undergraduates through the admission evaluation, with no separate application: Anam Global Scholarship (100% tuition for 8 semesters), Global Leader Scholarship A (100% for 4 semesters) and B (50% for 4 semesters), KU Global Friends (100% for 4 semesters, for applicants from Africa, South America or other developing countries), KU STEM Scholarship (100% for 4 semesters for proven STEM achievement) and Bright Futures (KRW 1,000,000 per semester for national scholarship recipients).

Continuation requires a GPA of 3.0-3.5 and 12+ credits each semester. Apply in the Fall 2027 international admission round (typically early spring); English-track and Korean-track programmes are available.

en: Up to 100% tuition for all 8 semesters
Special award for Africa, South America and developing countries
Automatic, decided at admission

eligibility.en: International freshmen (both parents and applicant non-Korean citizens, per KU admission rules) admitted through international admission.

en: Check the Fall 2027 international admission guide on Korea University's admissions site
Apply online with transcripts, language scores and essays
Submit STEM certificates or national scholarship proof if relevant
Scholarship decided with admission

costs.en: 50%-100% tuition for 4-8 semesters, or fixed KRW stipends.

score_reason: Generous automatic tuition awards; Fall 2027 dates not yet published.

name.en: McMaster University Award of Excellence for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: McMaster University-ის საუკეთესოობის ჯილდო საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: جائزة التميز في جامعة ماكماستر للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Applications open 1 Nov 2026 on AwardSpring; deadline 19 Feb 2027, 11:59 p.m. ET (McMaster international awards page).

summary.en: McMaster's Award of Excellence gives international students up to CA$200,000 over four years in Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences. Apply on AwardSpring between 1 Nov 2026 and 19 Feb 2027.
summary.ka: McMaster-ის საუკეთესოობის ჯილდო საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს ოთხ წელიწადში 200 000 კანადურ დოლარამდე აძლევს ბიზნესის, ინჟინერიის, ჰუმანიტარული, საბუნებისმეტყველო ან სოციალური მეცნიერებების ფაკულტეტებზე. განაცხადი AwardSpring-ზე 2026 წლის 1 ნოემბრიდან 2027 წლის 19 თებერვლამდე.
summary.ar: تمنح جائزة التميز في ماكماستر الطلاب الدوليين حتى 200,000 دولار كندي على أربع سنوات في كليات الأعمال والهندسة والإنسانيات والعلوم والعلوم الاجتماعية. قدّم عبر AwardSpring بين 1 نوفمبر 2026 و19 فبراير 2027.

about.en:
McMaster University in Hamilton, Ontario, is a top-200 research university known for health sciences, engineering and its DeGroote School of Business. Its Award of Excellence is worth up to CA$200,000 over four years for international fee-paying students with strong academics, community engagement and personal growth, entering Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences.

Apply through AwardSpring (opens 1 Nov 2026, closes 19 Feb 2027). McMaster also gives automatic international awards: DeGroote Business CA$15,000-25,000 in year one (renewable), Humanities and Social Sciences Scholars CA$10,000 (renewable at CA$5,000), Science Global Scholars CA$10,000 then CA$7,500/year, and Engineering/Computer Science international entrance awards of CA$10,000.

en: Up to CA$200,000 over four years
Automatic faculty awards of CA$10,000-25,000 too
Apply 1 Nov 2026 - 19 Feb 2027

eligibility.en: International fee-paying students entering full-time first year in Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences, staying in their admitted faculty.

en: Apply to McMaster through OUAC
Create an AwardSpring profile and complete the Award of Excellence application (from 1 Nov 2026)
Submit by 19 Feb 2027
Automatic faculty awards are assessed from your admission average

costs.en: Up to CA$50,000 a year toward international tuition (~CA$50,000-70,000).

score_reason: Large award open to internationals in five faculties; deadline 19 Feb 2027.

name.ka: University of Manitoba-ს საერთაშორისო საუკეთესოობის შესასვლელი სტიპენდია (2027/28)
name.ar: منحة القبول للتميز الدولي في جامعة مانيتوبا (2027/28)

deadline_note: Application and all documents (incl. one recommendation letter) due 1 Dec 2026; 2027/28 application is open (University of Manitoba awards page).

summary.en: The University of Manitoba awards one CA$25,000 and two CA$10,000 entrance scholarships to international first-years with strong grades and leadership. Apply with a recommendation letter by 1 Dec 2026.
summary.ka: University of Manitoba საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებს ანიჭებს ერთ 25 000 და ორ 10 000 კანადური დოლარის სტიპენდიას მაღალი შეფასებებისა და ლიდერობისთვის. განაცხადი სარეკომენდაციო წერილით 2026 წლის 1 დეკემბრამდე.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة مانيتوبا منحة قبول واحدة بقيمة 25,000 دولار كندي ومنحتين بقيمة 10,000 لطلاب السنة الأولى الدوليين المتفوقين ذوي القيادة. قدّم مع خطاب توصية قبل 1 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
The University of Manitoba in Winnipeg offers the International Excellence Entrance Scholarship: one award of CA$25,000 (requires a 90%+ admission average in five senior courses) and two of CA$10,000 (meet programme admission requirements), for international students entering first year full-time with demonstrated leadership and sustained community involvement.

You must complete a University of Manitoba admission application (fee paid) and the scholarship application with one recommendation letter from a current teacher or principal by 1 Dec 2026. Shortlisted applicants are ranked using both applications.

en: CA$25,000 top award
Leadership and community focus
Deadline 1 Dec 2026

eligibility.en: International students entering first year full-time (80%+ course load) in University 1 or a direct-entry faculty.

en: Apply for admission to the University of Manitoba and pay the fee
Complete the International Excellence Entrance Scholarship application
Arrange one recommendation letter from a teacher or principal
Submit everything by 1 Dec 2026

costs.en: One CA$25,000 and two CA$10,000 awards against tuition of roughly CA$20,000-25,000 a year.

score_reason: Small number of awards; deadline soon (1 Dec 2026).

name.ar: منحة القبول للطلاب الدوليين المتفوقين في جامعة سايمون فريزر — 140,000 دولار كندي (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Apply by 15 Dec 2026 (11:59 pm PT); references and admission documents by 31 Jan 2027. Portal offline until 2 Nov 2026 for maintenance (SFU USES page).

summary.en: SFU's International Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship is worth CA$140,000 over four years, with a possible living allowance for students with need. High-school applicants with 90%+ or 31 IB points apply by 15 Dec 2026.
summary.ka: SFU-ს საერთაშორისო შესასვლელი სტიპენდია ოთხ წელიწადში 140 000 კანადური დოლარია, საჭიროების შემთხვევაში შესაძლო საცხოვრებელი დანამატით. 90%+ ან IB 31 ქულის მქონე აპლიკანტები განაცხადს 2026 წლის 15 დეკემბრამდე აგზავნიან.
summary.ar: تبلغ قيمة منحة القبول للطلاب الدوليين المتفوقين في SFU 140,000 دولار كندي على أربع سنوات، مع بدل معيشة محتمل لذوي الحاجة. يتقدم الحاصلون على 90% أو 31 نقطة IB قبل 15 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Simon Fraser University in Metro Vancouver offers its Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarships (USES) to high-school applicants with outstanding academics and extracurricular excellence. The international award is CA$140,000 (eight terms of CA$17,500), and in limited cases an extra CA$8,000 per term living allowance goes to exceptionally talented students with financial need.

You need an SFU application for the Fall 2027 term and a student number, a 90% average or 31 IB points in required courses, and two references. Apply by 15 Dec 2026; references and admission documents are due 31 Jan 2027, and winners are announced mid-March to May 2027.

en: CA$140,000 over four years
Possible CA$8,000/term living allowance
Apply by 15 Dec 2026

eligibility.en: International high-school students graduating in 2027 (or 2026 without post-secondary study) with 90%+ or IB 31 in required courses.

en: Apply to SFU for Fall 2027 to get a student number
Complete the USES application by 15 Dec 2026
Have two referees submit references by 31 Jan 2027
Complete all admission To-Do List items by 31 Jan 2027

costs.en: CA$17,500 per term for 8 terms; tuition roughly CA$40,000-45,000/year.

score_reason: Large award with clear criteria; deadline 15 Dec 2026.

name.en: York University International Scholarship of Distinction & Merit Awards (Fall 2027)
name.ka: York University-ის საერთაშორისო გამორჩეულობის სტიპენდია და მერიტ ჯილდოები (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة التميز الدولية وجوائز الجدارة في جامعة يورك (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Automatic awards need no application; application-based awards use the International Student Scholarship & Award Application due 27 Jan 2027. Page values relate to the 2026-27 cycle and may change.

summary.en: York automatically gives international high-school applicants CA$37,500 (90%+ average) or CA$25,000 (80-89.9%) over four years. Application-based awards close 27 Jan 2027.

summary.ar: تمنح جامعة يورك تلقائيًا المتقدمين الدوليين من المدارس الثانوية 37,500 دولار كندي (معدل 90%+) أو 25,000 (80-89.9%) على أربع سنوات. تُغلق الجوائز التي تتطلب طلبًا في 27 يناير 2027.

about.en:
York University in Toronto automatically considers international students for entrance awards with no application: the York International Scholarship of Distinction (CA$37,500: CA$15,000 in year 1 and CA$7,500 in years 2-4, for 90%+ averages), the York International Merit Award (CA$25,000 for 80-89.9%), the York International Entrance Award (CA$5,000 for 75-79.9%) and the Glendon International Excellence Scholarship (CA$40,000 for top Glendon applicants).

Application-based options include the York Science Scholars Award (CA$10,000 incl. a summer research job; deadline 20 Feb 2027) and the separately listed President's International Scholarship of Excellence. The general International Student Scholarship & Award Application closes 27 Jan 2027.

en: Automatic CA$25,000-37,500 for strong averages
Glendon bilingual campus award CA$40,000
Science Scholars Award with summer research job

eligibility.en: International fee-paying students applying from high school (or with fewer than 24 transfer credits).

en: Apply to a York undergraduate programme for Fall 2027
Automatic awards are assessed from your final average
For application-based awards, submit the International Student Scholarship & Award Application by 27 Jan 2027
Accept your offer by the deadline and enrol full-time

costs.en: CA$5,000-40,000 over four years against tuition of roughly CA$35,000-40,000 a year.

score_reason: Automatic awards most strong applicants can get.

org: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan

name.en: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship — Undergraduate Students (2028 arrival)
name.ka: MEXT იაპონიის მთავრობის სტიპენდია — ბაკალავრები (2028 ჩასვლა)
name.ar: منحة الحكومة اليابانية MEXT — طلاب البكالوريوس (الوصول 2028)

deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate round closed in May-June 2026. The 2028 round is expected to be announced by Japanese embassies around April-May 2027 with deadlines in late spring/early summer 2027; dates vary by country.

summary.en: Japan's government scholarship pays tuition, a monthly stipend and return airfare for a full bachelor's degree in Japan, including a preparatory year of Japanese. You apply through the Japanese embassy in your country, usually in spring.
summary.ka: იაპონიის მთავრობის სტიპენდია ფარავს სწავლას, ყოველთვიურ სტიპენდიასა და ორმხრივ ავიაბილეთს სრული ბაკალავრიატისთვის იაპონიაში, იაპონური ენის მოსამზადებელი წლის ჩათვლით. განაცხადი თქვენს ქვეყანაში იაპონიის საელჩოს მეშვეობით, ჩვეულებრივ გაზაფხულზე.
summary.ar: تغطي منحة الحكومة اليابانية الرسوم الدراسية وراتبًا شهريًا وتذكرة سفر ذهابًا وإيابًا لدرجة بكالوريوس كاملة في اليابان، بما فيها سنة تحضيرية للغة اليابانية. التقديم عبر سفارة اليابان في بلدك، عادة في الربيع.

about.en:
The MEXT (Monbukagakusho) Undergraduate Scholarship is Japan's flagship government award for international high-school graduates. It covers university tuition and entrance fees, a monthly stipend (about JPY 117,000 in recent cycles) and a return economy ticket, for a one-year Japanese-language preparatory course followed by a four-year bachelor's (six years for medicine, dentistry, veterinary or pharmacy). Students study in Japanese at national universities.

Application is through the Japanese embassy or consulate in your country (embassy recommendation): first screening with written exams in maths, sciences or social studies, English and Japanese, plus an interview; MEXT then places successful candidates at universities from November with results early the following year. Applicants must be roughly 17-25 years old and have completed 12 years of school. Most embassies, including those covering Georgia and Qatar, open the call in April-May.

en: Full tuition + monthly stipend + airfare
Includes 1-year Japanese preparatory course
Apply via your local Japanese embassy

eligibility.en: Nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan, about 17-25 years old, who have completed (or will complete) 12 years of school. Must be willing to learn Japanese and study in Japanese. Each embassy may add rules.

en: Check the Japanese embassy website for your country from April 2027
Submit the application form, transcripts and certificates by the embassy deadline
Sit the embassy written exams and interview
If recommended, MEXT places you at a university; results early 2028

costs.en: Tuition and fees waived, monthly stipend (~JPY 117,000), return airfare; about 5 years (7 for medicine-type fields).

score_reason: Fully funded government scholarship; next round opens spring 2027.
