summary.en: Denison automatically considers international applicants for merit scholarships from US$5,000 a year to full tuition, and meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students. Internationals use a free Certification of Finances instead of the CSS Profile.
summary.ka: Denison საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს ავტომატურად განიხილავს მერიტ სტიპენდიებისთვის წელიწადში 5 000 დოლარიდან სრულ სწავლის საფასურამდე და მიღებულთა დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს ფარავს. საერთაშორისოები CSS Profile-ის ნაცვლად უფასო ფინანსურ სერტიფიკატს ავსებენ.
summary.ar: تنظر دينيسون تلقائيًا في المتقدمين الدوليين لمنح تفوق من 5,000 دولار سنويًا حتى الرسوم الكاملة، وتغطي 100% من الحاجة المثبتة للمقبولين. يستخدم الدوليون شهادة مالية مجانية بدل CSS Profile.

about.en:
Denison University is a residential liberal arts college in Ohio. International students are eligible for the same need-based aid as US students, and Denison meets 100% of each admitted student's demonstrated need. Every applicant is also automatically considered for merit scholarships ranging from US$5,000 a year to full tuition, awarded at admission.

To apply for need-based aid, tick the aid box on the Common App and upload the free Denison Certification of Finances (available from 1 Oct) to your portal. Denison does not accept the CSS Profile from international applicants. Deadlines: ED 1 on 15 Nov, ED 2 and RD on 15 Jan.

en: Merit from US$5,000/year to full tuition
100% of demonstrated need met
Free Certification of Finances, no CSS Profile

eligibility.en: International citizens applying as first-year students who request aid in their admission application (aid cannot be requested later).

en: Apply via Common App or Coalition by 15 Jan 2027 (RD)
Tick that you intend to apply for financial aid
Upload the Denison Certification of Finances in your portal
Merit and need awards arrive with admission

costs.en: Merit up to full tuition plus need-based grants up to full cost of attendance.

name.ka: Zayed University-ის პრეზიდენტის ჯილდო და მერიტ სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027)
name.ar: جائزة الرئيس ومنح التفوق في جامعة زايد للطلاب الدوليين (2027)

deadline_note: Awarded at the start of each Fall and Spring semester; applications must be submitted by the published date. Criteria page last updated April 2024: confirm current dates with Zayed University.

summary.en: Zayed University gives self-funding international undergraduates a President's Award (full tuition) or Academic Merit Scholarship (50% or 25%) based on school results and a maths test. Apply with a reference letter each Fall or Spring intake.
summary.ka: Zayed University თვითდაფინანსებულ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს აძლევს პრეზიდენტის ჯილდოს (სრული სწავლა) ან აკადემიურ მერიტ სტიპენდიას (50% ან 25%) სასკოლო შედეგებისა და მათემატიკის ტესტის მიხედვით.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة زايد طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين ذاتيي التمويل جائزة الرئيس (رسوم كاملة) أو منحة التفوق الأكاديمي (50% أو 25%) بناءً على نتائج المدرسة واختبار الرياضيات.

about.en:
Zayed University, a federal UAE university with campuses in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, offers limited scholarships to self-funding international undergraduates (tuition AED 2,500 per credit hour). The President's Award covers full tuition (e.g. 97% American/MOE, A*A British, IB 42, CBSE 95%, plus EmSAT Maths 1100 or SAT Maths 650); Academic Merit Scholarships cover 50% (90%, IB 36, SAT Maths 590) or 25% (85%, IB 33).

Submit the scholarship form with documents and a reference letter from your latest school by the published date; awards are made at the start of each Fall and Spring semester, and must be kept with a CGPA of 3.6 (President's) or 3.3 (Merit).

en: Full-tuition President's Award
Clear score thresholds
Fall and Spring intakes

eligibility.en: Self-funding international students admitted to Zayed University bachelor's programmes with high school results, a maths test (EmSAT/SAT) and three years of extracurriculars.

en: Apply for admission to Zayed University
Submit the scholarship form, transcripts, maths test score and a school reference letter by the published deadline
Award confirmed at the start of the semester

costs.en: 100%, 50% or 25% of tuition; housing, food, laptop and transport not covered.

score_reason: Clear criteria for full tuition, but dated page and limited awards.

name.en: ICU Peace Bell Scholarship & University of Tomorrow Scholarship (2027 entry)
name.ka: ICU-ს Peace Bell და University of Tomorrow სტიპენდიები (2027 მიღება)
name.ar: منحة جرس السلام ومنحة جامعة الغد في الجامعة المسيحية الدولية (قبول 2027)

deadline_note: English Language Based Admissions (ELBA) for April 2027 entry opened online on 1 Oct 2026; September 2027 entry follows. Scholarship applications go with the admission application; see the 2027 Admissions Guide for round deadlines.

summary.en: ICU's Peace Bell Scholarship covers matriculation, four years of tuition and on-campus dormitory fees for about 14 international entrants a year; the University of Tomorrow Scholarship adds living costs for one student from a Least Developed Country. Apply with your English-based admission application.
summary.ka: ICU-ს Peace Bell სტიპენდია ფარავს ჩარიცხვის საფასურს, ოთხი წლის სწავლასა და კამპუსის საერთო საცხოვრებელს წელიწადში დაახლოებით 14 საერთაშორისო სტუდენტისთვის; University of Tomorrow კი ყველაზე ნაკლებად განვითარებული ქვეყნის ერთ სტუდენტს ცხოვრების ხარჯებსაც უფარავს.
summary.ar: تغطي منحة جرس السلام في ICU رسوم التسجيل والرسوم الدراسية لأربع سنوات وسكن الحرم لنحو 14 طالبًا دوليًا سنويًا؛ وتضيف منحة جامعة الغد نفقات المعيشة لطالب واحد من الدول الأقل نموًا.

about.en:
International Christian University in Tokyo is Japan's leading English-and-Japanese bilingual liberal arts university. Applicants through English Language Based Admissions (ELBA) can apply for pre-enrolment scholarships: the ICU Peace Bell Scholarship (about 14 recipients; matriculation, tuition and facilities fees and on-campus dormitory fees for four years), the University of Tomorrow Scholarship (one student from a UN Least Developed Country; the same plus living expenses) and the ICU Torch Relay High Endeavor Scholarship (first-term tuition-level awards for four years).

No Japanese is needed for ELBA entry. ELBA online applications for April 2027 entry opened on 1 Oct 2026, with September 2027 entry rounds later; scholarship applications (essay and recommendation) are submitted with the admission application.

en: Full tuition + dormitory for 4 years (Peace Bell)
Living costs too for LDC students
No Japanese required to enter

eligibility.en: International applicants through ELBA (April or September 2027 entry). University of Tomorrow limited to nationals of UN Least Developed Countries.

en: Read the ICU Undergraduate Admissions Guide for 2027 (April/September entry)
Apply online via ELBA with essays and recommendation
Submit the scholarship application materials with your admission application
Scholars are selected before enrolment

costs.en: Peace Bell: matriculation, tuition, facilities and dorm fees for 4 years (about JPY 2 million/year); UoT adds living expenses.

score_reason: Full tuition + housing at a top Japanese liberal arts university; rounds open now.

name.en: George Swinburne International Excellence Scholarship — 30% Tuition (2027)
name.ka: George Swinburne-ის საერთაშორისო საუკეთესოობის სტიპენდია — სწავლის 30% (2027)
name.ar: منحة جورج سوينبرن للتميز الدولي — 30% من الرسوم (2027)

deadline_note: Automatic when you apply for an eligible 2027 intake at the Hawthorn campus; outcome stated in your letter of offer. No closing date published.

summary.en: Swinburne in Melbourne automatically gives eligible international students 30% off tuition for the standard length of their degree at its Hawthorn campus. No separate application is needed.
summary.ka: Swinburne მელბურნში შესაბამის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს ავტომატურად აძლევს სწავლის 30%-იან ფასდაკლებას Hawthorn-ის კამპუსზე პროგრამის სტანდარტული ხანგრძლივობით. ცალკე განაცხადი საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة سوينبرن في ملبورن الطلاب الدوليين المؤهلين تلقائيًا خصمًا بنسبة 30% من الرسوم طوال المدة القياسية للدرجة في حرم هوثورن دون طلب منفصل.

about.en:
Swinburne University of Technology in Melbourne is known for engineering, IT, design, aviation and business. The George Swinburne International Excellence Scholarship gives international students 30% off tuition for the standard course duration when they start an undergraduate or postgraduate course at the Hawthorn campus for the first time in 2027.

You are considered automatically when you apply for an eligible intake, and your letter of offer states the result. It cannot be combined with other Swinburne fee reductions; the Bachelor of Aviation and Piloting is excluded. Female engineering and construction students can alternatively get the 30% Women in Engineering Leadership Scholarship.

en: 30% off tuition for the whole course
Automatic with your application
Strong engineering, IT and design

eligibility.en: International students (not Australian/NZ citizens or PRs) starting an eligible course at Swinburne Hawthorn in 2027.

en: Apply for an eligible Swinburne course at Hawthorn for 2027
Meet entry requirements
Check your letter of offer for the scholarship

costs.en: 30% of tuition fees only (not OSHC or other fees).

score_reason: Automatic 30% award.

name.ka: Curtin-ის გლობალური სტიპენდიანტების პროგრამა — 15 000 ავსტრალიური დოლარი (2027 მიღებები)
name.ar: برنامج كيرتن للعلماء العالميين — 15,000 دولار أسترالي (دفعات 2027)

deadline_note: Follows Curtin's application key dates for each 2027 intake; check the application dates page for your starting campus.

summary.en: Curtin's Global Scholars start their bachelor's at a Curtin global campus (Malaysia, Dubai, Singapore or Mauritius) and transfer to Perth after one year, with an A$15,000 tuition scholarship for every accepted student.
summary.ka: Curtin-ის გლობალური სტიპენდიანტები ბაკალავრიატს Curtin-ის გლობალურ კამპუსზე იწყებენ (მალაიზია, დუბაი, სინგაპური ან მავრიკი) და ერთი წლის შემდეგ პერთში გადადიან, ყველა მიღებულისთვის 15 000 ავსტრალიური დოლარის სტიპენდიით.
summary.ar: يبدأ علماء كيرتن العالميون درجة البكالوريوس في أحد فروع كيرتن العالمية (ماليزيا أو دبي أو سنغافورة أو موريشيوس) وينتقلون إلى بيرث بعد عام، مع منحة 15,000 دولار أسترالي لكل طالب مقبول.

about.en:
Curtin University in Perth runs the Global Scholars Program: you start your bachelor's degree at one of Curtin's global campuses (Malaysia, Dubai, Singapore or Mauritius), complete about one year (200 credits), and then transfer to Curtin Perth without reapplying. Every accepted student receives an A$15,000 scholarship credited to tuition.

It suits students who want an Australian degree at lower overall cost, since first-year fees and living costs at the global campuses are typically lower than in Perth. You must be new to Curtin; eligible courses vary by campus.

en: A$15,000 for every accepted student
Start in Malaysia, Dubai, Singapore or Mauritius
Transfer to Perth without reapplying

eligibility.en: New-to-Curtin international students starting an eligible bachelor's at a Curtin global campus.

en: Choose an eligible course and starting campus
Apply to Curtin by the key date for your 2027 intake
Complete 200 credits, then transfer to Perth

costs.en: A$15,000 credited toward tuition (Perth international tuition roughly A$35,000-45,000/year).

score_reason: Guaranteed award with a cheaper first-year route.

org: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)

name.en: SUTD Undergraduate Scholarships for International Students — Rainmaker, Trailblazers, ASEAN (2027 intake)
name.ka: SUTD-ის საბაკალავრო სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის — Rainmaker, Trailblazers, ASEAN (2027)
name.ar: منح البكالوريوس في جامعة سنغافورة للتكنولوجيا والتصميم للطلاب الدوليين — Rainmaker وTrailblazers وASEAN (2027)

deadline_note: Scholarships are evaluated together with admission; indicate interest in your admission application. Check SUTD Undergraduate Admissions for AY2027 application windows (typically opening in October).

summary.en: SUTD considers international applicants for several scholarships, including SUTD Rainmaker (International), SUTD Trailblazers (International), ASEAN Undergraduate and sustainability scholarships covering full tuition plus travel and research grants. Just indicate your interest in the admission application.
summary.ka: SUTD საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს რამდენიმე სტიპენდიისთვის განიხილავს, მათ შორის SUTD Rainmaker, SUTD Trailblazers, ASEAN-ის საბაკალავრო და მდგრადობის სტიპენდიები, რომლებიც სრულ სწავლასა და კვლევის გრანტებს ფარავს. საკმარისია ინტერესის მითითება მიღების განაცხადში.
summary.ar: تنظر SUTD في المتقدمين الدوليين لعدة منح، منها SUTD Rainmaker وSUTD Trailblazers ومنحة آسيان للبكالوريوس ومنح الاستدامة التي تغطي الرسوم كاملة مع منح سفر وبحث. يكفي إبداء الاهتمام في طلب القبول.

about.en:
The Singapore University of Technology and Design, founded with MIT, teaches design-centred engineering, computing, architecture and design and AI. International applicants can be considered for scholarships including the SUTD Rainmaker (International), SUTD Trailblazers (International), SUTD Design and Engineering, ASEAN Undergraduate (for ASEAN nationals), Chong Tow Chong, Rock and Wilmar scholarships, plus sustainability scholarships that cover full tuition and add Sustainability Travel and Research Grants.

There is no separate form: indicate your interest in scholarships in the admission application, and SUTD evaluates admission and scholarship together. Each scholarship's page lists its coverage and any bond.

en: Full-tuition sustainability scholarships with research grants
Several awards open to internationals
Scholarship and admission evaluated together

eligibility.en: International applicants to SUTD's undergraduate programmes with academic excellence and leadership; ASEAN scholarships only for ASEAN nationals.

en: Apply to SUTD in the AY2027 undergraduate admission window
Indicate scholarship interest in your application
Attend interview/assessment if shortlisted

costs.en: Varies: up to full tuition (after Singapore Tuition Grant) plus grants, depending on the scholarship.

score_reason: Full-tuition options at a design-engineering university; window by intake.

name.en: Luther College Scholarships for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Luther College-ის სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح كلية لوثر للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Merit awards are automatic with admission (no deadline listed); talent scholarships have deadlines (Sustainability 1 Feb, Art 1 Mar, Theatre 29 Mar 2027). Apply early for full consideration.

summary.en: Luther College in Iowa automatically awards international students merit scholarships of up to US$39,000 a year plus Global Leaders awards, a guaranteed campus job and grants for health insurance and arrival.
summary.ka: Luther College აიოვაში საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს ავტომატურად ანიჭებს წელიწადში 39 000 დოლარამდე მერიტ სტიპენდიას, Global Leaders ჯილდოს, გარანტირებულ სამუშაოს კამპუსზე და გრანტებს დაზღვევისა და ჩამოსვლისთვის.
summary.ar: تمنح كلية لوثر في آيوا الطلاب الدوليين تلقائيًا منح تفوق تصل إلى 39,000 دولار سنويًا، إضافة إلى جوائز القادة العالميين ووظيفة مضمونة في الحرم ومنح للتأمين الصحي والوصول.

about.en:
Luther College is a liberal arts college in Decorah, Iowa, that strives to meet the financial need of admitted international students, though aid is limited and many families contribute half or more of costs. International students are automatically considered for Academic Merit Scholarships (up to US$39,000 a year) and Global Leaders awards (need and campus contribution), and all receive a health insurance grant (~US$1,800), a US$800 transition grant and a guaranteed on-campus job (~US$3,800).

Talent scholarships add more: Music (up to US$7,000/yr), Theatre (up to US$3,000/yr), Math (up to US$5,000/yr), Sustainability (up to US$1,250/yr, apply by 1 Feb) and Davis UWC (up to US$25,000/yr for UWC graduates).

en: Merit up to US$39,000 a year, automatic
Guaranteed on-campus job
Extra music, theatre, math and UWC awards

eligibility.en: International first-year applicants to Luther College.

en: Apply to Luther via Common App or Luther's application
Merit and Global Leaders awards are automatic
Apply for talent scholarships by their deadlines (Sustainability 1 Feb 2027)

costs.en: Merit up to US$39,000/yr plus grants against total cost of about US$65,000.

score_reason: Large automatic merit at a welcoming small college.

name.en: Mount Holyoke College Need-Based Aid & Merit Scholarships for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Mount Holyoke College-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება და მერიტ სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)

deadline_note: Mount Holyoke's Regular Decision deadline is typically 15 January (midyear report 15 Feb); confirm on its Application Deadlines page.

summary.en: 45% of incoming international students at Mount Holyoke receive need-based aid (average US$58,686) or merit scholarships (average US$17,500). Merit is automatic; need aid uses the CSS Profile.
summary.ka: Mount Holyoke-ის ახალი საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების 45% იღებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას (საშუალოდ 58 686 დოლარი) ან მერიტ სტიპენდიას (საშუალოდ 17 500 დოლარი). მერიტი ავტომატურია; დახმარებისთვის CSS Profile-ია საჭირო.
summary.ar: يحصل 45% من الطلاب الدوليين الجدد في ماونت هوليوك على مساعدة قائمة على الحاجة (بمتوسط 58,686 دولارًا) أو منح تفوق (بمتوسط 17,500 دولار). منح التفوق تلقائية؛ والمساعدة تتطلب CSS Profile.

about.en:
Mount Holyoke College is a women's liberal arts college in Massachusetts and part of the Five College Consortium, with one of the largest international communities of any US college. 45% of incoming international students receive need-based aid (average US$58,686) or merit scholarships (average US$17,500).

All applicants are automatically considered for merit aid. For need-based aid, submit the international CSS Profile and a parental tax return or income verification; non-aid applicants submit the International Financial Declaration. Test-optional, with English proficiency required for non-native speakers.

en: Average need award US$58,686
Automatic merit (average US$17,500)
Five College Consortium access

eligibility.en: Women (and gender-diverse applicants per college policy) of any nationality applying as first-years.

en: Apply via Common App or Coalition (RD typically 15 Jan 2027)
For aid: submit the CSS Profile and parental income documents
Merit is considered automatically
Send the midyear report by 15 Feb

costs.en: Need-based grants and merit scholarships toward cost of attendance (~US$85,000).

score_reason: Strong aid track record for internationals.
